description:
Halo Power Solutions is a residential electrical contractor based in Sherwood Park, Alberta, serving Edmonton, Strathcona County and surrounding communities.

We specialize in:
• Electrical panel upgrades
• 100A & 200A service upgrades
• Generac home standby generators
• EV charger installations
• Electrical safety inspections
• Flood damage electrical assessments
• Residential troubleshooting

Our mission is to educate homeowners while showing real jobs, real electrical hazards, and professional solutions.

Visit us at halopower.ca
